# Crosswalk.com

> > Crosswalk.com is a leading Christian living resource providing daily devotionals, prayers, Bible study tools, and faith-based news to help believers grow spiritually.

Crosswalk.com serves millions of Christians seeking daily spiritual guidance through a comprehensive collection of devotionals, topical prayers, Bible verses, and Christian news. The platform offers both free content and premium Crosswalk PLUS membership with exclusive video devotionals, marriage resources, and additional faith-building materials.

## Key Topics

- Daily Devotionals
- Prayer Resources
- Bible Study
- Spiritual Growth
- Christian Living
- Scripture & Bible Verses
- Crosswalk PLUS
- Marriage Devotionals
- Christian News
- Faith Encouragement
- Easter & Lent
- Women's Devotionals
- Evening Prayer
- Bible Reading
- Topical Prayers

## Daily Devotionals & Prayer

- [Daily Devotional - Crosswalk](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo): Daily Bible devotionals from Crosswalk writers for spiritual encouragement.
- [Your Daily Prayer and Morning Devotional for Today](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer): Daily morning prayer and devotional with Scripture for spiritual growth.
- [Your Nightly Prayer - Evening and Bedtime Prayer for Today](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer): Evening bedtime prayer devotional for daily peace and rest.
- [Your Daily Bible Verse - Today's Scripture Devotion](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse): Daily Scripture devotional with verse meaning and spiritual application.
- [Encouragement for Today - Proverbs 31 Women's Daily Devotional](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement): Daily devotional for Christian women from Proverbs 31 Ministries.
- [Devotionals - Short Daily Devotional for Today](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals): Hub for 50+ daily devotionals from pastors and Christian authors.

## Premium & Exclusive Content

- [Crosswalk PLUS - Premium Membership](https://www.crosswalk.com/plus): Crosswalk PLUS premium membership with exclusive devotionals and resources.
- [Crosswalk Marriage Devotional - PLUS Exclusive](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-plus-marriage-devotional): PLUS exclusive daily marriage devotional for couples' spiritual growth.
- [Video Devotionals - Crosswalk PLUS](https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/cw-plus-video-devo): Video devotionals exclusive to Crosswalk PLUS members.

## Prayer & Spiritual Guidance

- [Discover the Power of Prayer with Our Topical Prayers](https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/prayer): Directory of topical prayers for various spiritual needs and situations.

## Seasonal & Holy Day Resources

- [Easter & Holy Week Articles](https://www.crosswalk.com/special-coverage/easter): Easter and Holy Week articles focused on resurrection and celebration.
- [Lent Articles - Meaning of Holy Days, Prayers, Scriptures, and more](https://www.crosswalk.com/special-coverage/lent): Lent resources including prayers, fasting guides, and Easter preparation.

## Christian News & Updates

- [Christian News Headlines - Breaking and Trending Religion News](https://www.crosswalk.com/headlines): Breaking Christian news and trending religion headlines from worldwide.

## Core Features & Tools

- [Crosswalk - Homepage](https://www.crosswalk.com): Homepage offering daily Christian articles, devotionals, and faith resources.
- [My Crosswalk - Personalized Dashboard](https://www.crosswalk.com/my-crosswalk): Personalized user dashboard for saved articles and followed content.
- [Free Online Christian Crossword Puzzles](https://www.crosswalk.com/crossword): Free Bible-themed crossword puzzles for faith-based entertainment.

## Optional
